projects.title: Healthcare Claims Data Warehouse, ETL Mapping
projects.description:
Designed a Medicare claims data warehouse consolidating source systems and file specifications, building ETL mappings and BI report specifications that reduced requirements validation effort by 40% across a 4-sprint Agile project management cycle.
Achieved zero critical defects at UAT sign-off by authoring test plans and traceability matrices across 130+ source-to-target fields, validated through SQL-based test data creation and verification queries.
Gathered business and technical requirements across data subject areas by leading structured requirements workshops, analyzing entity relationship diagrams and database models to produce a phased ETL work breakdown structure.

projects.title: Retail Insights
projects.description: Analytics-engineering project on 541,909 real UK e-commerce transactions: a tested, documented dbt star schema feeding cohort retention, RFM segmentation, and window-function SQL, surfaced in an executive dashboard. Every metric is produced by dbt build with 79 passing tests — the engineering behind the numbers, not just a chart.

projects.title: Finances Database
projects.description: Personal-finance analytics project that builds a SQL database from raw transactions, layers reporting views on top, and surfaces spending and cash-flow trends in a dashboard.

projects.title: Data Pipeline with dbt, Airflow & GCP
projects.description: Automated data pipeline that ingests incoming data into BigQuery using Airflow DAGs, models it into a star schema with dbt, runs Soda data-quality checks, and reports through Metabase — orchestrated with Astronomer on Google Cloud Platform.

projects.title: Extracting Structured Data from PDFs
projects.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application that uses LLMs to extract structured fields — title, authors, summary, publication year — from research-paper PDFs, with a Streamlit interface and Docker containerization for deployment.

projects.title: E-Commerce Lakehouse (Medallion)
projects.description: An e-commerce lakehouse on Databricks and Delta Lake implementing a Bronze → Silver → Gold medallion architecture, with change-data-capture ingestion, SCD Type 2 history tracking, and customer segmentation served to BI/analytics.

projects.title: End-to-End Data Engineering System
projects.description: An end-to-end streaming pipeline that streams data from an API into a Kafka topic, processes it with Spark into PostgreSQL, and orchestrates the streaming and Spark jobs with Airflow — all built and run with Docker Compose.

projects.title: Sentinel — SOC Log Analytics
projects.description: A defensive, blue-team SOC log-analytics pipeline that ingests normalized security events, runs rule-based detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques alongside an unsupervised ML anomaly detector, scores detection quality against ground truth, and presents it in a Streamlit SOC console.

projects.title: Log Analysis & Anomaly Detection
projects.description: A log-analysis and anomaly-detection system that parses logs with regular expressions, extracts features, and uses an Isolation Forest model to flag unusual patterns that may indicate security threats, with real-time monitoring and visualization.

projects.title: Network Intrusion Detection (Deep Learning)
projects.description: A network intrusion detection system based on the NSL-KDD dataset that uses autoencoders together with KNN and LDA models to perform binary and multi-class classification of network attacks, loosely based on published research.

projects.title: SOC Automation Lab
projects.description: An automated Security Operations Center workflow built on virtual machines with open-source tools — Wazuh for detection, TheHive for case management, and Shuffle for orchestration — to detect, enrich (VirusTotal), and respond to incidents such as Mimikatz activity with real-time alerting.
